name: proxiapay
description: ProxiaPay — mobile money payment platform for Central and West Africa
//overrides: @nestjs/platform-express pins multer 2.2.0, which carries four denial-of-service advisories. No route here accepts multipart — statements arrive base64-encoded in a JSON body — so the package ships unreachable, but it still fails the audit gate. 2.4.0 is the same 2.x API outside the vulnerable range. Remove this once the platform depends on a patched multer itself.

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/console
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/console
